title.en: Capacitance and the parallel plate capacitor

body.en: A capacitor is two conductors separated by an insulator, carrying charges +Q and −Q. Its capacitance C = Q/V depends only on size, shape, separation and the medium, not on Q or V. Unit: farad (1 F = 1 C V⁻¹); practical units are μF, nF and pF. For two parallel plates of area A, separation d, in vacuum: $C = \varepsilon_0A/d$.
body.kn: ಧಾರಕ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟ +Q ಮತ್ತು −Q ಆವೇಶದ ಎರಡು ವಾಹಕಗಳು. ಧಾರಕತೆ C = Q/V, ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕ ಧಾರಕ: C = ε₀A/d.

points.en: Depends on geometry and medium only

narration.en: A capacitor is two conductors with equal and opposite charges. Capacitance is Q by V, measured in farad. For parallel plates in vacuum it is epsilon nought A by d.
narration.kn: ಧಾರಕ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟ +Q ಮತ್ತು −Q ಆವೇಶದ ಎರಡು ವಾಹಕಗಳು. ಧಾರಕತೆ C = Q/V, ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕ ಧಾರಕ: C = ε₀A/d.

narration.en: Connect the battery and the capacitor charges through the resistor: fast at first, then more and more slowly. After one time constant, R times C, it has gone 63 percent of the way. Disconnect it and it discharges the same way.
narration.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕ ರೋಧಕದ ಮೂಲಕ ಆವೇಶಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ: ಮೊದಲು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ, ನಂತರ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ. ಒಂದು ಕಾಲ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ R × C ನಂತರ 63 ಶೇಕಡಾ ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: With the battery connected the capacitor charges through R; switch it off and the capacitor discharges through R. The current is largest at the start and dies away. After one time constant $\tau = RC$ the voltage has gone 63% of the way.
caption.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದಾಗ ಧಾರಕ R ಮೂಲಕ ಆವೇಶಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಆಫ್ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ R ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಸರ್ಜಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ನಂತರ ಕುಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ. $\tau = RC$ ನಂತರ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ 63% ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: the parallel plate capacitor

narration.en: A parallel plate capacitor: two plates of area A, a distance d apart, carrying +Q and −Q. Between the plates the field is uniform, E = σ/ε₀, so V = Ed = Qd/(ε₀A). So the capacitance C = Q/V = ε₀A/d depends only on the size, shape and gap. Example: A = 6 × 10⁻³ m² and d = 3 mm give C = 17.7 picofarad. A dielectric filling the gap multiplies C by K; a slab of thickness t gives ε₀A over d − t + t/K.

say.en: A parallel plate capacitor: two plates of area A, a distance d apart, carrying +Q and −Q.
Between the plates the field is uniform, E = σ/ε₀, so V = Ed = Qd/(ε₀A).
So the capacitance C = Q/V = ε₀A/d depends only on the size, shape and gap.
Example: A = 6 × 10⁻³ m² and d = 3 mm give C = 17.7 picofarad.
A dielectric filling the gap multiplies C by K; a slab of thickness t gives ε₀A over d − t + t/K.

body.en: Filling the whole gap with a dielectric of constant K multiplies the capacitance by K: $C = K\varepsilon_0A/d$. A slab of thickness t (< d) gives $C = \varepsilon_0A/(d - t + t/K)$. A metal slab of thickness t behaves like K → ∞: $C = \varepsilon_0A/(d - t)$.
body.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t).

narration.en: Filling the gap with a dielectric multiplies C by K. A slab of thickness t gives epsilon nought A over d minus t plus t by K. A metal slab simply reduces the gap to d minus t.
narration.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t).

aim.en: To study the charging and discharging of a capacitor through a resistor and determine the time constant.

narration.en: Watch a capacitor fill with charge through a resistor. The voltage rises quickly at first and then levels off at the battery voltage: the capacitor is now storing Q equal to C V.

caption.en: Plates 3 mm apart. Slide a slab of dielectric constant K and thickness t (on the x-axis) into the gap: C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K).

tryThis.en: Set A = 60 cm² and t = 0: C = 17.7 pF, as in the example.
Raise t to 3 mm: the capacitance becomes K times larger.
Set K = 1: the slab changes nothing, whatever its thickness.

narration.en: Plates 3 mm apart. Slide a slab of dielectric constant K and thickness t (on the x-axis) into the gap: C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K). Set A = 60 cm² and t = 0: C = 17.7 pF, as in the example. Raise t to 3 mm: the capacitance becomes K times larger. Set K = 1: the slab changes nothing, whatever its thickness.

narration.en: Recap. C = Q/V; unit farad. Parallel plates: C = ε₀A/d. A dielectric multiplies C by K. Battery connected: V fixed; disconnected: Q fixed.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. C = Q/V; ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕಗಳು: C = ε₀A/d. ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತು C ಯನ್ನು K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ: V ಸ್ಥಿರ; ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿದಾಗ: Q ಸ್ಥಿರ.
